facts.fact: Culture Initiative观赛倡议：Logan首倡、Carson接龙促成
facts.anchor: Carson had piggybacked on the idea, suggesting that some of the NHL players attend a PWHL game to show support and raise awareness.

facts.fact: 观众规模堪比奥运——她职业生涯最大场面
facts.anchor: I hadn’t seen a crowd this large since I’d played at the Olympics.

facts.fact: 热身时中圈对视：secret smile+液体热流
facts.anchor: When our eyes met, the corner of his mouth lifted in a secret smile, and I felt a surge of liquid heat coursing through my veins.

facts.fact: 她打得生猛的原因：知道他在看
facts.anchor: I felt powerful because, out of all the people in the packed arena, I knew Carson was watching me.

facts.fact: 七月以来第一次同处一室（不算白天拍照环节）
facts.anchor: It was the first time we’d been in the same room together since last July

facts.fact: 婴儿名字赌局：她推销Logan，Boone推销Boone
facts.anchor: “Logan is perfect for a boy or a girl, just saying.”

facts.fact: Boone认真争当Hottie of the Week
facts.anchor: What do I have to do to be named as your Hottie of the Week?

facts.fact: Carson的报酬请求：一件签名的她球衣
facts.anchor: I’ll take one of your jerseys. And I’d like it signed, please.

facts.fact: 圣诞前礼物：Emerson Thorne-Crawford亲笔便签+电话号码
facts.anchor: I’m a big fan. Give me a call sometime. I’d love to chat.

facts.fact: 来历：Hawks节日活动上他提起了Logan，Emerson自称粉丝
facts.anchor: She attended a holiday event for the Hawks, and I mentioned you.

facts.fact: 雪夜街灯下的拥抱：他让她觉得安全——而他是她哥哥最恨的人
facts.anchor: How safe he made me feel, his arms wrapped securely around me—Carson. The man my brother loathed.

facts.fact: 结尾：她拉他手臂带路，卖关子“You’ll see.”
